_about: Localized thumbnail content for the captchas video. Source: thumbnails/round-2 (current shipped variants). round-1 fields are kept for the thumbnail-title.txt files; only round-2 is rendered to images. Each variant has rows[3] (each row is plain text; accent regions are wrapped in [[ and ]]) plus a YouTube title under ~60 chars. Accents are language-specific judgement calls based on visual punch and content emphasis.
